description: Ownership boundary enforcement. On Write/Edit/NotebookEdit, denies a write to any path outside the owns set of the wave declared in .drydock/wave-owns.json. Inert when that file is absent, which is the normal state of a repo not mid-wave. See hooks/enforce-owns.mjs for the config shape, the wave-level (not per-task) rationale, and the documented ceilings.
